title: What If You Fell Through the Earth?
lines: What if you jumped into a hole straight through the Earth?
First, the crust: | about {35 kilometers~thirty-five kilometers} of solid rock.
Then the mantle: | nearly {3,000 kilometers~three thousand kilometers} of hot rock.
Next, the outer core, | an ocean of liquid iron.
You'd pass the center | at {about/~about} {8 kilometers a second~eight kilometers a second}.
That's roughly {8 times~eight times} faster than a rifle bullet.
Then gravity flips, | and starts slowing you down.
You coast up the other side | and reach the surface, {12,700 kilometers~twelve thousand seven hundred kilometers} away.
The whole trip takes about {42 minutes~forty-two minutes}.
A straight tunnel from London to New York? | Also about {42 minutes~forty-two minutes}.
Through the Moon instead, | would the trip be shorter or longer? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Jump into a hole through the Earth, | and you'd reach the other side in {42 minutes~forty-two minutes}.
